verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a Machines REST API and publishes an OpenAPI spec, but the evidence never shows API version identifiers or a documented deprecation policy. The tagline "The API you start with is the API you keep" is a marketing statement about keeping the same primitives as you scale. It is not a versioning or deprecation commitment, so it counts only as adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
